name: steddle/foundry
description: What Steddle's imprints share: type, components and site behaviour.

suggest.laravel/mcp: For Steddle\Foundry\Mcp\ReadDocs, the read-docs tool an imprint's MCP server registers, and Steddle\Foundry\Mcp\HasImprintIcons (^1.0).
suggest.laravel/passkeys: For Steddle\Foundry\Concerns\ManagesPasskeys and foundry:passkeys, with @laravel/passkeys in the imprint's package.json (^0.2).
suggest.laravel/fortify: For the sign-in the foundry wires: its login view, limiters, password confirmation and Noindex (^1.37).
suggest.laravel/passport: For imprint.mcp: the consent screen, the OAuth hardening, Steddle\Foundry\Concerns\ManagesAgentConnections and foundry:agent-connections (^13.7).
suggest.laravel/sanctum: For Steddle\Foundry\Auth\DeleteAccount to delete an account's Sanctum tokens (^4.3).
